claim.claim-text: 1. A system (50) for deforming a plate member (52) on bone (56), comprising:

a plate member (52) having a pair of edge regions (99) located across the plate member from one another; and a bending tool (54) configured to be operatively associated with the pair of edge regions (99) by slideably mounting the bending tool (54) and the plate member (52) that displaces the bending tool (54) longitudinally on the plate member (52).

2. The system of claim 1, wherein the plate member (52) includes a body (98) having a bottom surface region (94), wherein each of the edge regions (99) has an underside that is elevated with respect to the bottom surface region (94), and wherein the bending tool (54) is configured to be engaged with the underside of each of the edge regions (99) when applying a moment to the plate member (52).
3. The system of claim 2, wherein the bending tool (54) is configured to be engaged with a top side (92) of the plate member (52) when applying the moment to the plate member (52).
4. The system of claim 1, wherein the bending tool (54) comprises:
a mating portion (120) configured to slideably mount to the plate member (52), and a shaft (84) mounted at an upper end of the mating portion (120).

5. The system of claim 4, wherein the mating portion (120) of the bending tool (54) forms a track (132), wherein at least a portion of the edge regions (99) are received by the track (132) when the bending tool (54) is slideably mounted to the plate member (52).
6. The system of claim 5, wherein the track (132) includes a groove (150) configured to receive at least a portion of one of the edge regions (99).

7. The system of claim 4, wherein the shaft (84) comprises a distal end portion (122) mounted to an upper end of the mating portion (120) and a proximal end portion (124) extending from the distal end portion (122) parallel to a mating axis (126) defined by the mating portion (120).

8. The system of claim 1, wherein the bending tool (54) and/or the plate member (52) include a stop region (140) configured to stop travel of the bending tool when the bending tool (54) is slideably mounted to the plate member (52).
9. The system of claim 1, wherein the bending tool (54) is a first bending tool (54a) and the system further comprises a second bending tool (54b).

10. The system of claim 1, wherein the plate member (52) comprises a main fixation plate (160) extending along a first axis and one or more ancillary plate members (162) extending orthogonal to the first axis.

11. The system of claim 10, wherein the one or more ancillary bone plates (162) are formed separately from the main fixation plate (160) and configured to be fastened with one or more fasteners (174) to the main fixation plate (160).
12. The system of claim 1, wherein the one or more ancillary plate members (162) are formed integrally with the main fixation plate (160).
13. They system of claim 1, wherein the plate member (52) comprises one or more openings (96), and the edge regions (99) bracket the one or more openings (96).

14. The system of claim 13, wherein the plate member (52) has a varying diameter along an axis (78) of the plate member (52), wherein the diameter of the plate member (52) around the one or more openings (96) is wider than the diameter of the plate member (52) between the one or more openings.

15. The system of claim 13, wherein the bending tool (54) is configured to be slideably mounted to the plate member (52) while one or more bone screws (58) occupy each of the one or more openings (96) of the plate member.
